draft.subject: Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Kanpur to Delhi Route
draft.body:
Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Kanpur to Delhi Route

Dear Orion Pharma Team,

Following a mechanical breakdown of vehicle UP86CM7252, a replacement unit (UP37RY4295) has been dispatched from the Kanpur hub.
The new vehicle is currently en route to Delhi with an estimated arrival time of approximately 12.6 hours.
We are monitoring the shipment closely to ensure timely delivery and will provide further updates as needed.
Please let us know if you have any immediate concerns regarding this adjustment.

Best regards,
Meridian Freight Dispatch
